fields.text: input type=text/tel/email with <label for>; required marked by * in the label and aria-required

choice.widget: react-select: input role=combobox aria-autocomplete=list aria-haspopup=true, id = question id; a hidden sibling input holds the chosen value
choice.open: a real mouse press on the control opens it; synthetic keydown/ArrowDown from page script does NOT
choice.options: rendered in the page (not a portal) in the listbox named by aria-controls (react-select-<id>-listbox); all options present (Country: 244), not virtualised
choice.filter: typing filters the options ("Unit" -> United States, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom)
choice.pick: type part of the answer, then click the option whose text matches; never press Enter (takes the first row)
choice.value_shown: div.select__single-value inside div.select__value-container; empty shows div.select__placeholder
choice.gotcha: Country beside Phone is the phone country: options read 'United States +1' -- match the leading text, not the whole option

fields.yes_no: react-select with Yes/No options (18+, authorized, sponsorship, non-compete, previously employed, worked for X)

file.which: resume vs cover letter only by the section heading above ('Resume/CV', 'Cover Letter'); both inputs are named 'Attach'
file.fill: set_input_files on the input[type=file] in the section whose heading says resume

fields.bot_trap: a hidden (not shown) required textarea labelled 'First Name*' -- never fill a field that is not visible
